object: TCRP (Corsican Pine) small scenery, 3D model v2

units_and_scale.convention: uniform sim/32 on all three axes: 1 Blender unit (BU) = 1 tile (32 sim XY units); land step (16 sim z) = 0.5 BU
units_and_scale.origin: tile centre in XY, z=0 at the tile base (ground)
units_and_scale.axes: Blender/OBJ-source: Z up. GLB is glTF Y-up (exporter export_yup); convert on load with x=gx, y=-gz, z=gy. OBJ written Y-up, -Z forward
units_and_scale.object_scale: 1.0 (scale applied; no squash in any exported file)
units_and_scale.height_note: trunk tip at sim z 134 = 4.1875 BU; trunk base sunk to sim z -3 (-0.094 BU) so it never floats on uneven land (same as v1)

render_only_z_squash.why: RCT dimetric projection draws 1 sim z unit as 1 screen px while XY tiles are 32 px wide per 32 sim; an orthographic camera matching the RCT angle needs Z scaled by sqrt(2/3) for heights to match the sprite pixel-for-pixel

rct_view_match.camera: orthographic, direction (d0,d1,KZ) normalised with (d0,d1) = (1,1),(-1,1),(-1,-1),(1,-1) for views 0-3; 128x192 px, ortho_scale=192/(32*sqrt2), shift_y=64/192 so origin lands at pixel (64,160)

facts: worldZ = bigZ*(0.5/16) i.e. sim z/32, guarded by a static_assert
camera target = map coords/32; terrain 1 unit per tile, Z up
lookAt up (0,0,1), X negated, 30 deg depression, 50 deg FOV
scenery is not drawn yet: no model loader exists
parkview_finding.conclusion: sim/32 models (Blender Z-up) match ParkView terrain as-is. Viewer still needs: a glTF loader (with Y-up -> Z-up conversion), placement at (tile+0.5, base z/32), alpha-test MASK (cutoff 0.5) with nearest filtering and no mipmaps, double-sided
parkview_finding.visual_note: A true 30-degree perspective view shows heights ~22% taller on screen than the RCT sprites (1.2247 px per sim z vs 1); this is expected and correct, not a model error
parkview_finding.survey_doc_conflict: docs/agents/scenery-sprites-angles-and-3d-view-survey.md line ~133 says model Z should be z/16, and line ~135 calls z/32 terrain-only; the ParkView code uses z/32 for terrain heights and kLandStepHeight 0.5, so z/16 would make models twice as tall as the terrain they stand on. v2 follows the code (z/32); the doc line should be corrected

parts: trunk: 8-sided flared tapered prism, 9 rings sim z -3..134, radius 4.4->0.5
14 foliage clumps, each: 4-sided tapered drooping main branch + 2 three-sided sub-branches; top card (48px pad tile), 6-card skirt ring leaning outward, underside card, crown card, 4 angled rim tufts

texture.palette: RCT sprite palette only: greens 142-150, browns 34-38, grey-blue 11-15
texture.filtering: NEAREST mag/min, no mipmaps, clamp (GLB sampler 9728/9728 patched by patch_glb_sampler.py); ~1 texel per sprite pixel
texture.alpha: MASK, alphaCutoff 0.5, doubleSided true (GLB patched from exporter's BLEND); Blender blend_method CLIP

fit.method: (1+1) random search over clump x,y,z,a,b,th; loss=1-mean silhouette IoU over 4 Workbench views vs sprite masks

files.compare_views.png: sprite vs render vs overlap per view
files.beauty_squashed_ref.png: perspective with render-only KZ squash, reference only

iou.source: Approved Blender 4.2 Workbench fit measured on 2026-11-01 against the four TCRP direction sprites. Mean silhouette IoU 0.725. The validator recomputes this only when a local sprite folder is passed.

rebuild: python make_texture2.py; blender -b -P build_tcrp2.py; python compare_views.py; python label_beauties.py
